annotations.text:
TODAY
Rows sit flat on the screen background with hairline dividers. The profile block is already a card — so the screen mixes both languages.

PROPOSED
Same rows, same tokens, now grouped into the card the rest of the app already uses: 16px radius, 1px #262521 border, #161615 fill. Gold section labels stay.

SUB-PAGE
Danger Zone becomes a destructive-tinted card (#2A1A1A on #3A2020) instead of loose red rows — both colours are already in the theme.
